script:
page.requestBody = {

    policyId: Number(page.policyId),

    claimantType:
        page.claimantType,

    lossDateTime:
        page.lossDate,

    lossLocation:
        (page.lossLocation || "").toString().trim(),

    lossType:
        page.lossType,

    lossDescription:
        (page.lossDescription || "").toString().trim(),

    driverName:
        (page.driverName || "").toString().trim(),

    driverLicenceStatus:
        page.licenceStatus,

    policeReportAvailable:
        page.policeReportAvailable === "YES",

    policeReportReference:
        page.policeReportAvailable === "YES"
            ? (page.policeReportReference || "").toString().trim()
            : "",

    repairEstimateAvailable:
        page.repairEstimateAvailable === "YES",

    supportingEvidenceReference:
        (page.supportingEvidenceReference || "")
            .toString()
            .trim(),
            
    estimatedLossAmount:
        Number(page.estimatedAmount),

    currency:
        page.currency || "INR",

    vehicleDrivable:
        page.vehicleDrivable === "YES",

    thirdPartyInvolved:
        page.thirdPartyFlag === "YES",

    injuryInvolved:
        page.injuryFlag === "YES",

    preferredContactMethod:
        page.preferredContact,

    preferredContactValue:
        (page.preferredContactValue || "").toString().trim(),

    createdBy:
        page.createdBy || "FNOL_USER"
};
